al-Maqarr al-Makhdumi, the above-mentioned (probably the same al-Makhdumi al-Ala'i of ff. 4r-6r)

technique_remarks: فلينظر إلى حسن معنى هذين البيتين وما فيهما من الصناعة - 'let one look at the beauty of meaning of these two verses and the craft (sina'a) in them' - praise; the craft is probably the hidden names / initial-letter device of f. 6r (not stated here)
plaintext_for: lines 7-8 verse (two lines: 'نفسي فدا...' / 'وردا وآسا...') is probably the plaintext of the large block that runs from f. 6r lines 11-13 to f. 6v lines 1-4; the new block on lines 11-13 has no plaintext on this page
certainty: medium: hand clear; line 7 verse words doubtful; line 8 list read with fair confidence; catchword at the foot not read.
